sites.name: Sleb Zdaw, the Ledge (V8)
sites.storm: above the cloud: clear, calm, gold light; bare wind-scoured rock; the fewest objects on the road
sites.story: B14 the look back (G14_LOOK_BACK over it); the Keeper stopped here once; then B15
sites.style: stone: a log bench behind two slabs laid level on the lip, held by a band of buried rock
sites.layout:
==== road (4,466-4,488 m, climbing 14 %) ====   path leaves the road at 4,471
     [log bench 3.5 m, along the contour]  shrubs in its lee
  rock  [slab A x1.10][slab B x0.95, stepped out]  rock      <- the ledge, level, facing east
        chinking stones at the downhill faces; the lantern fallen on slab A by the joint
            keel rock          spill of stones down the fall line (rubble dust)
   lower anchor rock + scree (down-road, downhill)            ... the valley, 3 km east ...
sites.notes: Story set V8 on the road site S24_Ledge. The V1 stand-ins (S24_Ledge_000..003) are removed by `clear`. The B14 trigger stays at 4,460; the set is centred 16 m up-road so the G14 hold frames it. Nothing religious, nothing modern; the lantern is never lit.
